articles.title: Coco Gauff's Cincinnati Win Sets Up US Open Run
articles.summary: Coco Gauff beat Jessica Pegula in the Cincinnati Open final, her first title of 2026. She's now a favorite for the US Open, starting August 30.

articles.title: Leon Marchand's New Olympic Dream: Freestyle
articles.summary: After winning 4 golds in Paris, Leon Marchand wants to race the 200m and 400m freestyle at the 2028 LA Olympics. He says he's found his 'thing'.

articles.title: My Own Private Nature Documentary: A Smart Nest Box Review
articles.summary: The Birdfy Nest Duo smart nest box has two cameras that let you watch birds hatch and grow. One reviewer saw chickadees lay eggs, feed babies, and even hiss at intruders.
